tasks.description: Season 2 is live. Photo the best thing you saw outside today and tell us the story behind it.
Review a spot in your city where locals actually watch football. Photo it and rate the atmosphere 1-10.
What does FAVOUR mean where you live? Photo something that shows how people help each other in your city.
Do a small favour for someone today. No money, just help. Tell us what you did and how it went.
Predict this week's biggest World Cup upset and say why. Best takes get bragging rights on the leaderboard.
Rate FAVOUR out of 10 this season. What should we build next? Most useful answer shapes the roadmap.
